3.2 Descent of symmetry ¶

Data: subduction_subgroups in JSON · GAP · Wolfram Language · SymPy

Conventions: sections 16.1 and 29.5.

Vector families. The vector families of 𝟤𝖣∞𝗁\mathsf{2D_{\infty h}} are those of 𝖣∞𝗁\mathsf{D_{\infty h}}. They restrict to the preimage 𝟤𝖧\mathsf{2H} of a closed subgroup 𝖧\mathsf{H} of 𝖣∞𝗁\mathsf{D_{\infty h}} as 𝖣∞𝗁\mathsf{D_{\infty h}} restricts them to 𝖧\mathsf{H} (vector_entry, vector_rules), whose irreps are the vector irreps of 𝟤𝖧\mathsf{2H}. The families restrict to a section as to its preimage. The tables are those of the section Descent of symmetry of the document of 𝖣∞𝗁\mathsf{D_{\infty h}}, with its settings. They are headed by the preimages and give the images of the generators of 𝖧\mathsf{H} at the points of the class space (section 1.2). Members of different families are not conjugate in 𝟤𝖣∞𝗁\mathsf{2D_{\infty h}}, also where they lie in one 𝖯𝗂𝗇−(𝟥)\mathsf{Pin^{-}(3)}-conjugacy class, such as 𝟤𝖣𝟣\mathsf{2D_{1}} and 𝟤𝖢𝟤\mathsf{2C_{2}} (a binary axis perpendicular to zz and along zz). The entry of row Γ\Gamma is Γ ⁣↓𝖧\Gamma\!\downarrow\mathsf{H} as a sum of the irreps of 𝖧\mathsf{H}.

Induction. For a finite subgroup 𝖧\mathsf{H}, Ind⁡𝖧𝟤𝖣∞𝗁Λ\operatorname{Ind}_{\mathsf{H}}^{\mathsf{2D_{\infty h}}} \Lambda has infinite dimension: by Frobenius reciprocity it contains each irrep of 𝟤𝖣∞𝗁\mathsf{2D_{\infty h}} as often as its restriction to 𝖧\mathsf{H} contains Λ\Lambda (Conventions, section 12.4).
